text: Macro Federalism and Local Finance presents the following source proposition: Several aspects of these systems are examined: (a) institutional design to achieve internal economic union; (b) policies for regional development; (c) conduct of monetary policy; (d) coordination of fiscal policies, with a special emphasis on tax harmonization; and (e) management of risks of insolvency from sub-national borrowing. This proposition is pertinent to Kaal's source-bound claim that Government decentralization at the local level can favor local elites and may overcomplicate the coordination of national policies. The proposed response is an extension: the relationship should remain limited to the retrieved source proposition and the mapped Kaal claim unless fuller source review supports a broader conclusion.
